engine.name: gemini
engine.style: Read this aloud like a friendly presenter: warm, clear and natural, at a lively pace

format: 24 kHz mono 16-bit WAV, peak -3 dBFS, 0.25 s of room at the end
replace: To use the real Ghost-Prime voice, save each line as the same file name (any sample rate; edit.mjs resamples), keep `text`, update `seconds` and `engine`, then run edit.mjs.

lines.text: Ghost-Prime, by Ivan Lucky. Use a computer just by talking.
lines.spoken: Ghost Prime, by Ivan Lucky. Use a computer just by talking.

lines.text: Ghost-Prime is an AI assistant on a school Chromebook. You talk or type, and it does the task.
lines.spoken: Ghost Prime is an AI assistant on a school Chromebook. You talk or type, and it does the task.

lines.text: Now it reads the web for you. It opens Wikipedia, types the search itself, reads the article, and explains it in three simple sentences. Every step shows as a card.
lines.spoken: Now it reads the web for you. It opens Wikipedia, types the search itself, reads the article, and explains it in three simple sentences. Every step shows as a card.

lines.text: It remembers you from one day to the next. Tell it something once; the memory is stored on the Chromebook.
lines.spoken: It remembers you from one day to the next. Tell it something once; the memory is stored on the Chromebook.

lines.text: In a brand-new chat, it still knows: what you just said, and what it learned before.
lines.spoken: In a brand-new chat, it still knows: what you just said, and what it learned before.

lines.text: Reminders, for homework and revision. Two minutes from now it speaks up, in the chat and out loud.
lines.spoken: Reminders, for homework and revision. Two minutes from now it speaks up, in the chat and out loud.

lines.text: Files too. It writes a three-day revision plan and saves it in a new folder. What it creates with its file tools can be undone.
lines.spoken: Files too. It writes a three-day revision plan and saves it in a new folder. What it creates with its file tools can be undone.

lines.text: Safety for teachers. In plan mode it only looks: asked to delete that folder, it explains what it would do and changes nothing. An 'are you sure?' pop-up is next.
lines.spoken: Safety for teachers. In plan mode it only looks: asked to delete that folder, it explains what it would do and changes nothing. An 'are you sure?' pop-up is next.

lines.text: That's Ghost-Prime. Come and try it live at the booth.
lines.spoken: That's Ghost Prime. Come and try it live at the booth.
